critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.jsx uses Math.random() in the render path for the 'Conv. Rate' KPI (line 406) — this causes the value to jitter on every re-render (e.g., when switching filters). Consider using a deterministic seed derived from filteredRows/dateRange so the number is stable.
ProductDetail.jsx is 580 lines — approaching complexity threshold. Consider splitting each tab (Overview, Attributes, Variants, Performance, History) into its own component for maintainability.

buildTrend() adds noise per point but the sum won't necessarily equal units_sold_30d; the KPI 'Units Sold' shown in Performance uses r.units_sold_30d directly regardless of dateRange — so the KPI number does NOT actually change when switching 30d→7d (only the chart x-axis shrinks). The date-range filter is essentially cosmetic for KPIs. Might be intentional for a prototype but worth confirming with product owner.
History tab filter uses substring match on log.detail — could yield false positives if SKUs share prefixes. Consider structured logs with sku field.
